notes.title: [DevLog_5] Goblin Dungeons
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/1edf98c19f81b5a2b94fce83ead49c25fb07e254.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197740
Greetings, adventure seekers! Time to share the development progress of our dark fantasy world. Over the past months, we have significantly expanded gameplay possibilities by adding numerous new mechanics.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/931ce98871725fd24034d2ff8db3b44671d7f2a1.gif[/img]

🔮 [b]Magic and Spellcasting System[/b]
Now you can study ancient magical arts! Customize your spellbook, choose your starting spell, and block those you don't like.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/9a8cf219318db0b2d4162fe5fa0f4aa4e80c994c.jpg[/img]

⚒️ [b]Crafting System[/b]
Create unique equipment from gathered materials. Upgrading your gear will allow you to challenge the most dangerous enemies in the depths of dungeons.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/6a0181f2c3ab3daefde2779b65c185c00176db0b.jpg[/img]

🃏 [b]Collectible Cards[/b]
Over 300 unique cards await their collectors! Each card is tied to a random event in the game and will reveal new facets of our dark world.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/593ba070a367202446f20c0cd050ce161fcf1677.jpg[/img]

💕 [b]Intimate Scene Progression[/b]
The enhanced character relationship development system has received new progression mechanics and expanded content.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/c06a9828ef22218b80b5dc4eb0fc27760d616417.jpg[/img]

👹 [b]Enemies and Bosses[/b] (50% complete)
Work on the bestiary is in full swing! Over 100 unique enemies and their variations will be created in total. From small demonic creatures to mighty dungeon bosses.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/bfbed94aae6d3aeb5a0d186719f029e1308173fb.jpg[/img]

🏰 [b]Dungeons[/b]
5 unique dungeons with their own distinctive content await you. Explore grim catacombs, ancient crypts, and monster lairs to battle powerful bosses in their depths.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/1f165b181a4d676d22da9cbec86ea597c0f62a3c.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197740
Stay tuned for updates, your support and feedback inspire us to create unforgettable adventures - your [url=https://discord.com/invite/s72EyyDaN6]Loolust[/url]!

notes.title: [DevLog_4] Goblin Dungeons
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/790b1492b3fee18a1de50815b761909b072458ef.jpg[/img]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197740/Goblin_Dungeons/]Goblin Dungeons[/url][/b] - add the game to your wishlist!

Dear friends! A lot of work has been done on the game over the past period. The game is 50% complete. We want to share with you what has been done.

[b]CAMP[/b] (A place to rest and prepare for new adventures)
The location is fully animated, lighting and effects have been installed. Post-processing has been added.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/4631b1e878907822f46b6e362a558abb1b34c06c.gif[/img]

[b]MAGIC[/b]

[b]Fire[/b] 15/15 - 100% ready
The peculiarity of fire is to inflict additional damage to the enemy.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/6212f9615899b8271a2a7a3c6443da325d64975c.gif[/img]

[b]Ice[/b] 13/15 - 86% readiness
Spells of this school have a chance to freeze the enemy and block his abilities.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/fd0868cba740c95be57f51ee6fea883509a12052.gif[/img]

[b]DIALOGUES[/b]
The game will have a full-fledged dialogue system. You will be able to communicate with both allies and enemies. The heroine will also not miss the opportunity to comment on the events taking place on the screen.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/aef3b53e8be9e4a8844729a2bc7e54784c4133cb.gif[/img]

[b]ENEMIES[/b]
We are trying to implement a wide variety of opponents with different abilities and patterns of behavior in battle. 5 unique story bosses will be added.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/b50dc8fa8a56b9756a00c54b6ade7d5ee9e4a30a.png[/img]

[b]PLANS[/b]
Poison Magic School,
Lightning Magic School,
Non-elemental spells,
Items,
Random events,
Story cutscenes,
Music and sounds,
Voice acting,

[b]BONUS[/b]
We are planning to release a cosplay of the game's main character Ellie by the game's release. Work on it is in full swing. More information about our games and key giveaways in [url=https://discord.gg/s72EyyDaN6][b]Discord[/b][/url]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/c033d291afadac6589b53c05a9804c5ce53b3b76.jpg[/img]

Dear friends, time flies very quickly, but we are trying to keep up. Work on the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197740/Goblin_Dungeons/]game[/url][/b] is in full swing. We have almost finished the base for the combat system. We have developed a convenient tool for the combination of Unity and Spine, which greatly speeds up and simplifies adding new scenes and enemies. We also held a vote in our [b][url=https://discord.gg/s72EyyDaN6]Discord[/url][/b] on whether to add XRAY to the game. Players voted for adding it. XRAY is already in the works.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/488b089febc72a3b2042b1c4ef0dc88a51c1a1e0.jpg[/img]

We are also adding enemies and spells to the game as they become ready. Baby Bomber is an enemy that will explode and cause a lot of damage if you do not manage to kill him in a certain number of rounds.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/87d24be3c9ca9a57388fe9912fccf4de16fe8d66.gif[/img]

The Warrior is a dangerous enemy with a large set of abilities, a high level of health and a ferocious disposition. A very dangerous enemy.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/053f3ca6b71d7dfad82a20336d14d71c7485ecb3.gif[/img]

The Troll is very big and stupid, but can withstand the most powerful spells. Has a huge supply of health and a strong blow that can discourage the desire to fight him.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/4c33210c2fb2eb7f6f690532a6f3ccf026a1df2e.gif[/img]

The next few days will focus on the link and adding XRAY to the sex scenes. Adding a reward system. Finishing the player base concept and getting it up and running. Until next time!

notes.title: Goblin Dungeons | DevLog #1
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/3a9de64e119a65c7001d5dce5d7736e1de55f404.png[/img]

Development of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197740/Goblin_Dungeons/][b]Goblin Dungeons[/b][/url] is in full swing and there is already something to talk about. The game will combine roguelike and autobattler. We will gradually go into the depths of the dungeon, meeting enemies and treasures. For victories, the player will be given abilities and rewards to choose from. By killing goblins, the player will be able to take their members, this is the local currency for which you can buy new abilities and items. If you lose, the player will be fucked by a goblin, a new interactive sex scene will open, and the dungeon will start from the beginning.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/463b60544b731e79d30c5d235cf22028db0a0b36.jpg[/img]

According to the plot, we play as a girl who was electrocuted while masturbating and was reborn in another world that is suffering from a goblin invasion. The local deity gives her magical powers and makes a deal with her. If she kills the goblin king and stops the invasion, he will return her home.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/cf98422caf2225dc5f8c7d310db17be97206352a.jpg[/img]

The plans include implementing several schools of magic and a large number of spells with the ability to combine them during combat pauses. Goblins will be endowed with the ability to use various abilities that will cause the player a lot of problems. I will try to tell more details in the following posts.

notes.title: Say hello to the new succubus
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312754/48d3cde75b58cbad6acd54c0c61a2a5e2055c279.png[/img]
We have good news, we have added 2 new playable succubus at once! And they are ready to train.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312754/873b334d8abe58fd7d3b131168a1803c27115c1a.png[/img]

More girls will be added to the game soon. Thanks for your support! We work for you!

notes.title: Bia prepare for the summon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312754/5a5b7672b0d075110ad1a7e634d355c09c3156e2.jpg[/img]
Biya will be available for summoning very soon. 
The team is approaching the final work on a new demon. Wait a little more and a new girl will be available for summoning. We really hope you enjoy

notes.title: Octopussy has been added to the game
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312754/472b9350ca07e4dff49e56b1b621b0a8107fd94b.png[/img]
Finally the day has come! Another succubus has been added to the game. Meet Octopussy, the water succubus will fulfill all your desires.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312754/9deb5d691b5c9435d5e0ca17b43fa7adac6f6282.jpg[/img]

Our team is also working on a new succubus, which will also be added to the game soon. We remind you that we listen to your opinion on Twitter. If you want to influence the development of the game, write reviews.

notes.title: This summer will be hot!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312754/9deb5d691b5c9435d5e0ca17b43fa7adac6f6282.jpg[/img]
Our team is working on the octopusy. And we are happy to announce that it will appear in the game this summer. If you have any suggestions for improving the game, we are always ready to listen.

notes.title: Ready to summon a succubus?
notes.notes:
Hey! very soon we will launch 69 Summon Succubus in early access and start working on a new creature for summoning and training. We look forward to your feedback and suggestions. In the meantime, you can watch the new gameplay trailer on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1727100]page[/url].

P.S. And we have not yet come up with a name for the water princess.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312754/472b9350ca07e4dff49e56b1b621b0a8107fd94b.png[/img]
